hotel.name: The Grand Executive
hotel.description: Five-star hotel located in the heart of Paseo de la Reforma. Designed to offer an exceptional inclusive experience where every guest, regardless of ability, enjoys absolute comfort and autonomy.
hotel.location: Paseo de la Reforma, Mexico City
hotel.address: Paseo de la Reforma 222, Col. Juárez, CDMX, México
hotel.heroImageAlt: Facade of The Grand Executive, a five-star hotel on Paseo de la Reforma, Mexico City

wheelchair.title: Accessible Rooms
wheelchair.description: Spacious rooms with grab bars, adapted showers, and wheelchair-accessible space.

visual.title: Visual Assistance
visual.description: Braille signage, audio description, and equipment for people with low vision.

auditory.title: Hearing Assistance
auditory.description: Visual alarms, amplified telephones, and hearing loops in common areas.

mobility.title: Mobility
mobility.description: Wheelchairs available, ramps in all areas, and spacious elevators.

sensory.title: Sensory-Friendly
sensory.description: Rooms with acoustic insulation, adjustable lighting, and low-stimulation zones.

guide.title: Personal Guide
guide.description: Personalized assistance for guests with visual or cognitive disabilities.

gym.name: Gym
gym.description: Adapted equipment with low-impact exercise machines, virtual weights, and audio-guided training. Step-free access from the lobby.

pool.name: Pool
pool.description: Submerged access ramp, hydraulic pool transfer chair, adapted changing rooms with grab bars, and emergency shower.

bar.name: Bar
bar.description: Counter at 75cm height with knee clearance for wheelchairs. Braille menu and large-print 24pt menu available.

restaurant.name: Restaurant
restaurant.description: Tables with knee clearance for wheelchairs, Braille menu, tactile floor indicators, and staff trained in accessibility protocol.

bank.name: Banking Partner
bank.description: ATM with touch screen, audio output for transactions, Braille emergency button, and wheelchair-accessible space.

shuttle.name: Transfers
shuttle.description: Adapted vehicles with manual access ramp, wheelchair anchors, and space for assistive equipment luggage. 24-hour service.

exchange.name: Currency Exchange
exchange.description: Preferential service at an 80cm-high counter with knee clearance. Foreign currency and traveler's check exchange with no commission.

spa.name: Spa
spa.description: Treatment area with height-adjustable electric massage tables, hot tub with ramp access, and therapists trained in assisting people with disabilities.

events.name: Event Hall
events.description: Stage with access ramp, adjustable LED lighting, hearing loop audio system, and wheelchair spaces in front of the stage.

meeting.name: Meeting Rooms
meeting.description: Accessible round tables with central wheelchair space, large screen with real-time captions, and wireless microphone system.

elevator.name: Elevators
elevator.description: Three elevators with Braille buttons, floor audio announcements, panoramic mirrors, and capacity for 15 people or 2 wheelchairs simultaneously.

parking.name: Parking
parking.description: 10 accessible parking spaces near the entrance, with 1.50m transfer zone, vertical signage, and ramp to the lobby.

store.name: Store
store.description: Wide 1.50m aisle without obstacles, shelves at a maximum height of 1.20m, accessible checkout counters, and step-free entrance with automatic door.

laundry.name: Laundry
laundry.description: Washers and dryers at 80cm height, 90cm wide doors, pickup and delivery service directly to the room at no additional cost.

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy
pharmacy.description: Room delivery within the hotel, accessible counter in the lobby, medications organized in Braille blister packs, and dosage reminder service.

suitePresidencial.name: Accessible Presidential Suite
features: Smart TV with subtitles and SDH
suitePresidencial.altDescription: Spacious suite with king-size bed, wide turning radius for wheelchairs, private bathroom with roll-in shower, chrome grab bars, height-adjustable furniture, and visual alert system. Panoramic view of Paseo de la Reforma.

suiteJunior.name: Accessible Junior Suite
suiteJunior.altDescription: Elegant suite with queen-size bed, adapted bathroom with curbless shower and grab bars, height-adjustable desk, and bedside visual alarm. View of the shopping center.

habitacionEstandar.name: Adapted Standard Room
habitacionEstandar.altDescription: Double room with adapted bathroom including grab bars next to the toilet and in the shower, bedside visual alarm, portable hearing loop available upon request, and full-width doors for comfortable access.

maria.name: María García
maria.text: For the first time in my life, I felt truly free in a hotel. Everything was perfectly adapted, from the shower to the desk.

carlos.name: Carlos Mendoza
carlos.text: The staff assisted me with incredible dedication. I was able to move around with total autonomy thanks to the Braille system and audio description.

ana.name: Ana Ruiz
ana.role: Mother of a child with ASD
ana.text: The low-stimulation room was an oasis for my son. We were able to enjoy our vacation without stress or sensory overwhelm.

auditory-kit.label: Hearing Accessibility Kit
auditory-kit.description: Visual doorbell, vibrating alarm clock, and portable hearing loop

guide-dog.label: Guide Dog Accommodation
guide-dog.description: Bed, bowls, and designated area for assistance dog

transfer-crane.label: Transfer Crane
transfer-crane.description: Ceiling-mounted system for mobility between bed and wheelchair

braille-menu.label: Braille Menu and Documentation
braille-menu.description: Restaurant menu, hotel directory, and signage in Braille

special-diet.label: Special Diet
special-diet.description: Food allergies, restrictions, or specific dietary needs

visual-assistance.label: Personalized Visual Assistance
visual-assistance.description: Guided accompaniment throughout the hotel facilities

wheelchair.label: Complimentary Wheelchair
wheelchair.description: Manual or motorized wheelchair during your stay

hospital-bed.label: Hospital or Anti-Reflux Bed
hospital-bed.description: Articulated bed with side rails and remote control

main-entrance.label: Main Accessible Entrance
main-entrance.description: Concrete ramp with 6% slope, automatic revolving door 1.40m wide + 1.20m side door. Doorbell with visual indicator and non-slip flooring.

parking-spot-1.label: Reserved Accessible Parking 1
parking-spot-1.description: Wide parking space 3.80m wide, striped transfer zone, wheelchair icon in blue. Located near the main entrance.

parking-spot-2.label: Reserved Accessible Parking 2
parking-spot-2.description: Second accessible space with the same specifications. Obstacle-free area and vertical sign with accessibility symbol.

emergency-exit-north.label: Emergency Exit - North
emergency-exit-north.description: Emergency staircase with panic bar, green EXIT symbol, and step-free evacuation ramp. Automatic emergency lighting.

reception.label: Inclusive Reception
reception.description: L-shaped counter with different heights: 75cm for wheelchair users and 90cm for standing persons. Knee clearance of 70cm. Built-in hearing loop.

main-elevator.label: Inclusive Elevator
main-elevator.description: Panoramic elevator with international accessibility symbol. Braille buttons, floor audio, and full-length side mirror. Capacity for 15 people or 2 wheelchairs.

lobby-bathroom.label: Adapted Bathroom - Lobby
lobby-bathroom.description: Unisex public bathroom with 1.50m transfer space, chrome grab bars, emergency alarm with flashing light, and mirror at 90cm height.

pool.label: Adapted Pool
pool.description: Depth from 0.90m to 1.40m. Features a 6m submerged access ramp and a hydraulic pool lift with SIA symbol for safe transfer.

spa.label: Spa and Treatments
spa.description: 3 massage cabins with electric adjustable tables from 45cm to 90cm. Hot tub with access ramp and therapists trained in assisting people with disabilities.

gym.label: Adapted Gym
gym.description: 400m² with 12 adapted exercise machines, audio channel trainer, digital weights, and stretching area with minimum 1.50m wheelchair clearance.

restaurant.label: Accessible Restaurant
restaurant.description: 80 covers with 15 wheelchair-accessible tables (knee clearance). Braille menu available upon request. Service surface at 85cm height.

kitchen-bathrooms.label: Kitchen and Public Bathrooms
kitchen-bathrooms.description: Service area with adapted public bathrooms. Left and right grab bars at toilet, luminous alarm, and wide 90cm step-free doors.

rooms-floor-3-a.label: Accessible Rooms - Floor 3 Wing A
rooms-floor-3-a.description: 4 rooms with 90cm doors, bathrooms with grab bars, bedside visual alarm. 1.50m turning radius. Step-free floor transition.

rooms-floor-3-b.label: Accessible Rooms - Floor 3 Wing B
rooms-floor-3-b.description: 4 additional rooms on the same floor with the same accessibility specifications. Wide obstacle-free hallway.

rooms-floor-4-a.label: Junior Rooms - Floor 4 Wing A
rooms-floor-4-a.description: 4 adapted rooms with roll-in shower, height-adjustable desk, and portable hearing loop available. View of the inner courtyard.

rooms-floor-4-b.label: Junior Rooms - Floor 4 Wing B
rooms-floor-4-b.description: Junior Suite with 1.20m entrance, full bathroom with grab bars, and articulated bed. Maximum comfort amenities.

floor-bathroom.label: Floor Common Bathroom
floor-bathroom.description: Adapted bathroom on each floor near the elevators. Bilateral grab bars at toilet, luminous alarm visible from hallway, and shift changing table.

route-lobby-pool.label: Accessible Route Lobby-Pool
route-lobby-pool.description: Obstacle-free path with non-slip flooring, minimum width of 1.50m, and ramps where there are level changes. Connects the lobby with the pool area.

events-room.label: Accessible Event Hall
events-room.description: Stage with access ramp, adjustable LED lighting, hearing loop audio system, and 20 wheelchair spaces in front of the stage.

meeting-rooms.label: Accessible Meeting Rooms
meeting-rooms.description: Accessible round tables with central wheelchair space, large screen with real-time captions, and wireless microphone system.

laundry-service.label: Adapted Laundry
laundry-service.description: Washers and dryers at 80cm height, 90cm wide doors, pickup and delivery service directly to the room at no additional cost.

pharmacy-service.label: Accessible Pharmacy
pharmacy-service.description: Accessible counter in the lobby, medications organized in Braille blister packs, dosage reminder service, and in-room delivery within the hotel.
